languageParity: Every AI-generated public text must be available in HR and EN with identical substance.
principleHr: AI smije operativno raditi, razvijati projekte, predlagati odluke, voditi workere, stvarati javne objave i monetizacijske prijedloge, osim onoga što je izričito zabranjeno ili traži ljudsko odobrenje.
principleEn: AI may operate, develop projects, propose decisions, manage workers, create public posts and monetization proposals, except for actions explicitly prohibited or requiring human approval.

hr: AI smije objavljivati javne financijske analize, projekcije, operativne signale i projektne KPI komentare.
Takve objave nisu knjigovodstvena izvješća, nisu revizorski dokumenti i nisu službeni financijski izvještaji.
Stvarni knjigovodstveni podaci, bankovni podaci, privatne evidencije i osobni podaci ne smiju u javni sloj.
Ako objava tvrdi službeni prihod, dobit, dug, kapital ili pravni učinak, ide u ljudski pregled prije objave.
en: AI may publish public finance analyses, projections, operating signals and project KPI comments.
Such posts are not accounting reports, audit documents or official financial statements.
Real accounting data, bank data, private records and personal data must not enter the public layer.
If a post asserts official revenue, profit, debt, equity or legal effect, it goes to human review before publication.

modules.hr: AI upravlja workerima, 9 projekata, dnevnim ciklusima, prioritetima i reportima.
modules.en: AI manages workers, 9 projects, daily cycles, priorities and reports.
modules.approval: operator visibility unless action is restricted

modules.hr: AI organizira i vodi radne sastanke workera, generira zapisnik, odluke, prijedloge i zadatke.
modules.en: AI organizes and runs worker meetings, generating minutes, decisions, proposals and tasks.

modules.hr: AI razvija monetizacijske prijedloge, partner pipeline, product tasks i revenue experiments za 9 projekata.
modules.en: AI develops monetization proposals, partner pipeline, product tasks and revenue experiments for the 9 projects.

modules.hr: AI priprema originalni HR/EN sažetak vijesti iz allowlist izvora bez kopiranja cijelog teksta.
modules.en: AI prepares an original HR/EN news summary from allowlisted sources without copying full article text.
modules.approval: auto if category is allowed and no restricted flags

modules.hr: AI priprema javne operativne finance/KPI objave koje nisu knjigovodstvena izvješća.
modules.en: AI prepares public operating finance/KPI posts that are not accounting reports.
modules.approval: auto only for public signal; human review for official claims

modules.hr: AI vodi paper trading i tržišne simulacije bez stvarnog novca te uči iz rezultata.
modules.en: AI runs paper trading and market simulations without real money and learns from results.

modules.hr: AI čita media prijavu, sažima redakciju, provjerava nedostajuća polja i predlaže status.
modules.en: AI reads the media application, summarizes the outlet, checks missing fields and suggests status.

modules.hr: AI priprema individualni nacrt maila za operatora, ali ga ne šalje kao kampanju.
modules.en: AI prepares an individual email draft for the operator but does not send it as a campaign.

modules.hr: AI priprema 3 dnevna izvješća po workerima: jutro, sredina dana i večer.
modules.en: AI prepares 3 daily worker reports: morning, midday and evening.

hr: AI se koristi kao operativni upravljački sloj za workere, projekte, sažetke, klasifikaciju, prijedloge i javne operativne objave.
AI može objavljivati dopuštene javne newsroom i projektne finance-signal objave, ali one nisu knjigovodstvena izvješća ni službeni financijski izvještaji.
AI može voditi simulacije trgovanja i paper trading bez stvarnog novca.
AI ne šalje masovne mailove, ne pokreće kampanje, ne koristi stvarni novac i ne mijenja infrastrukturu bez ljudskog odobrenja.
en: AI is used as an operating management layer for workers, projects, summaries, classification, proposals and public operating posts.
AI may publish allowed public newsroom and project finance-signal posts, but they are not accounting reports or official financial statements.
AI may run trading simulations and paper trading without real money.
AI does not send mass emails, launch campaigns, use real money or change infrastructure without human approval.
